messages.author: Ifeoma Okonkwo
messages.text: Headroom on the events line is approved minus committed minus reserved; the 2,800 Quayside deposit for platform day and the 800 pending on ADJ-2200 are reserved. Contingency for a 20-person event is 800 under the current table.

messages.author: Rui Saldanha
messages.text: Rafael and Liam are basic fares — forfeited, new tickets at 300. Inês, João, Marc, and Niko re-issue for their recorded fees. Standard queue tickets on 31 July.

messages.author: Maren Achterberg
messages.text: AP-DK-0108 is an adjustment up to 4,000 on the events line, standard queue. Ciarán's board review on 28-29 July is protected — only Petra could move it — so the 27 July week is out. Anything above the ceiling or a reclass from recruiting is Ifeoma's.
